research_question: Does a label-aware but non-deployable 0/8/16/32-byte progressive residual-code oracle expose broad, compression-consistent Recall@10 headroom over the best design-frozen 640-byte matched-access comparator, including a strong fixed 16-byte sidecar?
scope: development-only matched-access feasibility; no learned allocator, storage-compression claim, QAT, deployment, or external confirmation

source_pool.historical_disclosure: All 3,961 queries previously participated in v2 development. The new audit role is withheld only from v3 design; it is not independent or untouched confirmation.

data_policy.label_lineage_disclosure: The ephemeral v2.2 inner_train bundle may first be re-materialized with the exact frozen v2.2 builder, which necessarily reopens the historical shared qrels JSON and reproduces the preregistered parent hashes. V3 builder/evaluator code does not open qrels. It reuses only the exact hash-registered candidate_relevance and relevant_counts arrays in that parent bundle. A separate V3 process selects oracle_design label rows before design and oracle_audit label rows only after design_freeze.json is durable. The parent source array is procedurally, not cryptographically, sealed; this is a development audit, not independent confirmation. Future-holdout identity rows are written only for split auditing; their candidate and label payload rows are never selected or written by V3. Closed-role rows are used only for identity-overlap auditing and never for candidates, labels, or metrics.

frozen_retrieval.base_index: the exact hash-registered v2.2 inner_train IVF-PQ M32 nlist512 nprobe16 candidate arrays
frozen_retrieval.candidate_source: deterministic row subset of the exact frozen v2.2 inner_train Top-100 arrays

progressive_representation.basis: one uncentered second-moment truncated-SVD rank-32 residual basis fit without labels on oracle_design candidate-union residuals
progressive_representation.orientation: largest-absolute entry in every basis column must be non-negative
progressive_representation.prefix_contract: 8, 16, and 32 are prefixes of the same ordered rank-32 code; per-tier basis fitting is forbidden
progressive_representation.scale: one design-frozen global max-absolute scale per coefficient: max_abs / 127
progressive_representation.zero_tier: no sidecar read and exactly zero correction

score_references.Exact40: ann score plus exact FP32 query-residual dot product at frozen base ranks 1 through 40; ranks 41 through 100 remain base
score_references.Exact100: ann score plus exact FP32 query-residual dot product for all frozen Top-100 candidates
score_references.QrelCandidate100: candidate-pool relevance packing ceiling; diagnostic only
score_references.interpretation: Exact40 and Exact100 are compression-consistent score-rescore references, not qrels-optimal or deployable methods

matched_access_oracle.label: QUERY_LABEL_ORACLE_NON_DEPLOYABLE
matched_access_oracle.fixed_candidates: ranks 41 through 100 use rate 0 and still compete for Top-10
matched_access_oracle.objective: maximize judged-relevant count in final Top-10, equivalent to maximizing per-query Recall@10
matched_access_oracle.solver: exact dynamic program over every stable score threshold, Top-10 selected count, and 8-byte budget unit
matched_access_oracle.optimality_requirement: enumerate all candidate-rate threshold keys and return the proven global optimum
objective_ties: deterministic threshold and ascending document-ID traversal
matched_access_oracle.storage_caveat: This oracle assumes a full rank-32 progressive code could exist. It constrains accessed code bytes, not persistent serialized storage.

registered_matched_baselines.selection_metric: highest Recall@10; ties use fewer accessed bytes then lexical method name

metric_contract.primary_contrast: Oracle16 minus the design-frozen best matched 16-byte baseline

counterfactual_recovery.secondary_reference: positive per-query Exact40-minus-Base Recall mass, reported but not gated

formal_decisions.INVALID: Any lineage, split, hash, solver-optimality, byte-budget, artifact, or access-policy check fails
formal_decisions.KILL_NO_SCORE_HEADROOM: Exact40 leaves less than 0.010 Recall@10 over the frozen primary comparator or has no positive comparator-relative compression-recovery mass
formal_decisions.STOP_NO_HEADROOM: The matched-access oracle fails any primary effect, CI, support, harm, concentration, fold, or recovery gate
formal_decisions.GO_TO_STATIC_STORAGE_ORACLE: All matched-access checks pass; this authorizes only a separately frozen static-storage oracle protocol

design_freeze_must_register: basis, scales, singular values, adjacent singular-value gaps, and sample rows
all registered baseline per-query scores and selected primary comparator
design oracle scores, rate assignments, fold diagnostics, and exact-solver preflight
access gates, bootstrap contract, budgets, and execution environment
protocol, source, builder, core, and evaluator hashes
split audit, future identity, bundle-freeze summary, query role manifests, candidate arrays, and design role labels
artifact_policy.complete_run_reuse: only when the fingerprint and every top-level and design-freeze registered output hash match recursively

prohibited_actions: editing this protocol after any oracle result is observed
using v2.2 inner-validation, outer, clean-test, NQ, or TREC outcomes
reading or materializing future_method_holdout labels or metrics in this gate
materializing oracle_audit labels before design_freeze.json is durable and verified
retrieving or reordering candidates instead of subsetting the exact frozen v2.2 inner_train arrays
fitting a separate basis or scale for each tier
calling the query-label oracle a deployable method
claiming persistent-storage savings from the accessed-byte oracle
starting training, QAT, or an external evaluation from this result
